policies.name: One PR Per Branch
policies.description: A feature branch maps to exactly one open PR.

conditions.message: Branch '{branch}' has no open PR. Open one: gh pr create

policies.name: Stack Integrity
policies.description: A stacked PR references a valid, merged (or open) parent.

conditions.message: Stack parent is invalid (missing base or unmerged base).

policies.name: Squash Merge Only
policies.description: PRs merge via squash to keep main history linear.

conditions.message: Use squash merge: gh pr merge <n> --squash
